name: The launcher thief
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, fleeing with a huge bronze rocket launcher with glowing orange chambers stuffed in a sack on its back, cackling, looking back over its shoulder

poses.stand: flying fast forward to the right on beating bat wings, the big launcher in a sack on its back, looking back over its shoulder cackling
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers
poses.windup: coiled into an exaggerated Cuphead wind-up, the part that will hurt flaring with a bright glow, held still a beat

idle.action: flies hard forward, wings pumping, the launcher sack bouncing on its back

move.action: flies away forward fast with the launcher sack on its back, cackling, wings pumping, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers

windup.action: pulls into a held glowing wind-up pose for a clear telegraph beat, no strike yet

attack.action: snaps forward into its strike, then recovers

style: Hand-inked 2D arcade character like Hollow Knight and Cuphead: heavy warm near-black outline (#140B0D), flat two-tone cel colour (base + one shadow), one thin rim of hellfire light, a readable silhouette at 48 px, no soft airbrush, no gradients beyond two tones, no pure black #000000, side view facing right
background: Plain flat pure green background (#00ff00), no floor, no shadow, no scenery, even studio lighting.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, soft airbrush, gradient shading, watercolor wash, pure black outline, text, watermark, busy background, extra limbs, blurry, low contrast silhouette, camera movement, zoom, pan
